summary: Spacious ground floor flat with modern fitted kitchen, utility room, two double bedrooms, and bathroom. Features gas central heating and double glazing. Excellent public transport links, close to amenities and city by-pass. Ideal for first-time buyers or buy-to-let investors.
description:
This spacious ground floor flat offers comfortable and practical living accommodation, ideally suited for first-time buyers or the buy-to-let market. The property comprises a bright living area, a modern fitted kitchen with an adjoining utility room, providing excellent additional storage and convenience.

There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, complemented by a contemporary bathroom. The flat benefits from gas central heating and double glazing throughout, ensuring warmth and energy efficiency.

Situated close to a range of amenities, the property enjoys excellent public transport links and is conveniently positioned near the city by-pass, offering easy access to surrounding areas. This well-presented flat combines comfort, convenience, and accessibility, making it an attractive opportunity for purchasers seeking a practical home or investment. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the accommodation and location on offer.

Directions From the town centre follow Dalston Road. Pass Dunmail Drive and take the next right onto Woodend Drive. Turn left onto Levens Drive, then fourth left on to Rashdall Road.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is on road.
